# Town of Granville municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 10; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Town of Granville, Minutes of the Annual Town Meeting, March 3, 2026 (granvillevermont.org): Robert Readie was elected to a three-year term (26 votes to Kevin Bagley's 10) and Jared Rouleau to the two years remaining on a term ending 2028 (24 votes); the board is Readie, Rouleau, and Michael Eramo, whose term runs to 2027.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists Granville's three selectboard members as Michael Eramo, Robert Readie (Chair), and Jared Rouleau -- concordant with the town's own 2026 meeting minutes.
Town of Granville, Minutes of the Annual Town Meeting, March 3, 2026 (granvillevermont.org): Kelli Eckroth was elected Moderator for the ensuing year and presided over the March 3, 2026 meeting.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Cheryl Sargeant as Granville town clerk.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2026 VT Town Clerk Contact Info' spreadsheet: lists Cheryl Sargeant as Granville town clerk.
Town of Granville 2026 Town Report (granvillevermont.org): the March 3, 2026 Warning is attested by Cheryl L. Sargeant as Town Clerk; no clerk election stood in 2026.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Nancy Needham as Granville town treasurer.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2026 VT Treasurers' Contact Info' spreadsheet: lists Nancy Needham as Granville town treasurer.
Town of Granville 2026 Town Report (granvillevermont.org): no treasurer election stood at the March 2026 meeting.
Town of Granville, Minutes of the Annual Town Meeting, March 3, 2026 (granvillevermont.org): Nancy Needham was re-elected Collector of Delinquent Taxes for the ensuing year.
Town of Granville, Minutes of the Annual Town Meeting, March 3, 2026 (granvillevermont.org): Mark Belisle was re-elected First Constable for a two-year term ending 2028.
Town of Granville, Minutes of the Annual Town Meeting, March 3, 2026 (granvillevermont.org): Jennifer Stickney was elected Second Constable, 13 votes to Jeffrey Lumbra's 10.
Town of Granville, Minutes of the Annual Town Meeting, March 4, 2025 (granvillevermont.org): Jennifer Stickney was likewise elected Second Constable in 2025.

Town of Granville, Minutes of the Annual Town Meeting, March 3, 2026 (granvillevermont.org): Veronica Parrish was elected Cemetery Commissioner to a three-year term ending 2029 (the Second seat in the commission's First/Second/Third rotation).

Town of Granville, Minutes of the Annual Town Meeting, March 4, 2025 (granvillevermont.org): Kate Stauss was elected Cemetery Commissioner to the two years remaining on a term ending 2027, and William Brokof to a three-year term ending 2028. The commission's First, Second, and Third seats rotate on the pattern the two meetings' minutes fix.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists five justices of the peace for Granville.
